# k0rdent_vpc_peering (List Resource)

Finds every `k0rdent_vpc_peering` a `terraform query` can adopt, by its identity. With `include_resource = true`, or under `-generate-config-out`, each result also carries the object as an import of that identity would read it, so the generated configuration is what an import plans against. Terraform 1.14 and later.

Every peering on one VPC, or on every VPC in a project. An object being deleted is left out: adopting it plans against something about to be gone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every peering on every VPC in the provider's project.
list "k0rdent_vpc_peering" "all" {
  provider = k0rdent
}

# The peerings on one VPC.
list "k0rdent_vpc_peering" "training" {
  provider = k0rdent

  config {
    vpc = "vpc-ml-training"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to search. Defaults to the provider's `project`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `region` (String) Region to search. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `vpc` (String) VPC to search. Left out, every VPC in the project is searched. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL. String length must be at most 63.
